simple.meaning: נִצָּה (nitstsâh) is a Hebrew word meaning “a blossom.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: נִצָּה (H5328) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Job 15:33, with occurrences in Job, Isaiah.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to נִצָּה (H5328) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in נִצָּה (H5328) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: נִצָּה (nitstsâh) / H5328 is traced through Job 15:33, Isaiah 18:5 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.
